THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION CHACHODA DISTRICT GUNA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI A.P.S. TOMAR-PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER Case diary is available.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant as he has been arrested on 10.01.2023 in connection with Crime No.349/2021 registered at Police Station Chachoda, District Guna for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 34 of IPC.
Prosecution story, in brief, is that, applicant was Gram Rojgar Sahayak of Gram Panchayat Narayanpura.

He along-with Sarpanch and Sachiv of the aforesaid Gram Panchayat prepared forged and fabricated muster roll receipts and other documents and withdrew an amount of Rs.14,94,000/-
in respect of construction of four ponds, while the said ponds were not found to be constructed.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant by referring to Rule 20 of M.P. Gram Panchayat (lekha) Niyam,
1999, submits that applicant was not authorized/entitled to withdrew money and the alleged amount was withdrew by co-accused persons.
The applicant did not prepare any forged document and he did not assist the co-accused, even than he has been implicated in the matter.

He further submits that during investigation, the amount, which is said to be defalcated by the applicant and other co-accused persons, has already been deposited vide receipt dated 04.08.2021 issued by Chief Municipal Officer, Janpad Panchayat Chachoda, District Guna.
The investigation has been completed and chargesheet has been filed.
No further custodial interrogation is required.
He is in custody since 10.01.2023 and the trial will take time to conclude, therefore, in the aforesaid circumstances, applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

Learned counsel for the respondent/State has vehemently opposed the prayer and submits that applicant being Gram Rojgar Sahayak of Gram Panchayat Narayanpura prepared muster roll and other documents in connivance with co-accused persons and withdrew aforesaid amount.

The bail application of co-accused Takhat Singh was rejected by this Court vide order dated 24.01.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.3988/2023 and the case of applicant is similar to that of co-accused Takhat Singh, therefore, he is not entitled for bail.

In reply, it is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that vide order dated 24.01.2023, the bail application of co-accused-Takhat Singh was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file afresh in the week commencing 12.06.2023.
Heard the learned counsel for both the parties.

Having considered the rival submissions, material pointed out by the learned counsel for the applicant and that the charge sheet has been filed and other facts and circumstances of the case,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, hence the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr.P.C.
M.Cr.C. stands disposed of, accordingly.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
